title: Shuang Shi
text:
Shuang SHI

Assistant Professor


School of Economics, Nankai University Tianjin, 300071, China


shuangshi.nku@gmail.com







I am Shuang SHI (written as 石爽 in Chinese, pronounced as Shawn Shih).
Currently, I am an Assistant Professor at Nankai University’s School of Economics. I received my PhD in Economics from the Business School at The University of Hong Kong. My research interests lie in Economic History and Development Economics, with a focus on the rise of mega-states across the world and the role of major infrastructure in historical China. My teaching includes Data Visualization, Spatial Data Analysis, and Chinese Economic History.
